summary:
PROJECT GHOST (Galactic History of Our Silent Travelers) is an interactive educational project developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

It explores the stories of human-made equipment left behind during space exploration, focusing on the Moon, Mars and deep-space missions. Through an interactive 3D solar-system visualization and an artifact catalogue, users can discover selected spacecraft, landers, rovers and scientific instruments, understand their original purposes, and learn about their missions and current status.

The project aims to make space exploration history engaging and accessible to students and young explorers. By bringing these forgotten machines back into the spotlight, PROJECT GHOST encourages curiosity about astronomy, planetary science, robotics and space engineering.
details:
PROJECT GHOST (Galactic History of Our Silent Travelers) is an interactive educational archive created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

The project explores the history of human-made equipment left behind during space exploration. It presents a collection of 12 mission artifacts across five destination zones, including the Moon, Mars and deep-space destinations.

The website features an interactive 3D solar-system schematic built using Three.js. Users can explore destination zones, browse the artifact catalogue, filter records by destination and operational status, and open individual mission records to learn about the purpose and history of each object.

The project also includes an Archive Guide that answers questions using a collection of curated fact cards. It is a local, rule-based feature rather than a live generative AI chatbot.

The interface was developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Three.js and Vite. AI assistance was used to generate and structure initial code and draft explanatory content. The project is designed as an educational prototype to encourage students to learn about space exploration, planetary science and the engineering behind historic missions.

The 3D solar-system scene is illustrative and not to scale. Mission locations and statuses are presented with appropriate limitations, and the archive is not intended to be a complete inventory.

PROJECT GHOST aims to make the history of space exploration more accessible by remembering the machines that helped humanity explore beyond Earth.
